spec.title: Top models by requests/s
spec.description: Busiest models by request rate (1h avg).

spec.title: Top models by time spent
spec.description: Models ranked by time spent serving them, most time-efficient first (lowest is best; seconds per second over the selected time range).

spec.title: Top models by tokens/s
spec.description: Models by generated tokens per second (1h avg).

spec.title: Generation duration
spec.description: Heatmap of generation (eval) duration distribution over time (5m rate per time bucket).

spec.title: Load duration
spec.description: Heatmap of model load duration distribution over time (5m rate per time bucket).

spec.title: Prefill duration
spec.description: Heatmap of prompt processing (prefill) duration distribution over time (5m rate per time bucket).

spec.title: Response duration
spec.description: Heatmap of end-to-end response duration distribution over time (5m rate per time bucket).

spec.title: Tokens per second
spec.description: Heatmap of per-request generation speed distribution over time (5m rate per time bucket).

spec.title: Mem (RSS)
spec.description: Resident memory of the exporter process.

spec.title: Virt mem
spec.description: Virtual memory of the exporter process.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU cores used by the exporter process (5m rate).

spec.title: Open FDs
spec.description: File descriptors currently open by the exporter process.

spec.title: Max FDs
spec.description: File descriptor limit of the exporter process.

spec.title: FD usage %
spec.description: Open file descriptors relative to the process limit.

spec.title: Scrape churn
spec.description: New time series added per second by the exporter target and samples dropped per scrape by metric relabeling (5m rate window).

spec.title: Exporter CPU
spec.description: CPU cores used by the exporter process over time (5m rate window).

spec.title: Exporter FDs
spec.description: Open file descriptors of the exporter process over time.

spec.title: GC collections
spec.description: Python garbage collection runs per second by generation (5m rate window).

spec.title: GC objects
spec.description: Python objects collected and uncollectable per second by the garbage collector (5m rate window). Uncollectable above 0 indicates reference cycles keeping objects alive.

spec.title: Exporter memory
spec.description: Resident and virtual memory of the exporter process over time.

spec.title: Up
spec.description: 1 when the Ollama exporter target is scraped successfully, 0 when down.

spec.title: Resp avg
spec.description: Average end-to-end response duration per request (sum/count, selected time range).

spec.title: Gen time
spec.description: Total generation time accumulated.

spec.title: Gen avg
spec.description: Average generation duration per request (sum/count, selected time range).

spec.title: Models
spec.description: Number of distinct models that served requests.

spec.title: Top model %
spec.description: Share of requests handled by the busiest model over the selected time range.

spec.expr: 100 * max(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) / clamp_min(sum(rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])), 1e-9) or vector(0)

spec.title: Samples
spec.description: Total samples scraped from the exporter target within the selected time range.

spec.title: Scrape
spec.description: Average scrape duration of the exporter target within the selected time range.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Time since the exporter process started.

spec.title: Req
spec.description: Total requests proxied since exporter start.

spec.title: Req/s
spec.description: Average requests per second over the selected time range.

spec.title: Tok in
spec.description: Total input (prompt) tokens processed.

spec.title: Tok in/s
spec.description: Input tokens per second over the selected time range.

spec.title: Tok out
spec.description: Total output tokens generated.

spec.title: Tok/s
spec.description: Average generation speed (tokens per second) while generating, over the selected time range.

spec.title: Resp time
spec.description: Total end-to-end response time accumulated.

spec.title: Cached tokens/s
spec.description: Prompt-cache token reuse per second. Awaits importer support: ollama_cached_tokens_total.

spec.title: Request errors/s
spec.description: Failed requests per second. Awaits importer support: ollama_requests_failed_total.

spec.title: GPU memory
spec.description: GPU memory used and total. Awaits importer support: ollama_gpu_memory_used_bytes / ollama_gpu_memory_total_bytes.

spec.title: GPU temperature
spec.description: GPU temperature. Awaits importer support: ollama_gpu_temperature_celsius.

spec.title: GPU utilization
spec.description: GPU utilization percentage. Awaits importer support: ollama_gpu_utilization_percent.

spec.title: Running / queued requests
spec.description: Concurrent inference requests running on and queued by Ollama. Awaits importer support: ollama_num_requests_running / ollama_num_requests_waiting (official Ollama /metrics names).

spec.title: Avg durations by stage
spec.description: Average duration per request stage: generation, load, prefill and response over the selected time range.

spec.title: Generation time by model
spec.description: Share of time spent generating per model over the selected time range.

spec.title: Load time by model
spec.description: Share of time spent loading models per model over the selected time range.

spec.title: Prefill time by model
spec.description: Share of time spent processing prompts per model over the selected time range.

spec.title: Requests by model
spec.description: Share of total requests per model.

spec.title: Response time by model
spec.description: Share of end-to-end response time per model over the selected time range.

spec.title: Tokens by model
spec.description: Share of generated (output) tokens per model.

spec.title: Tokens/s by model
spec.description: Share of generation speed per model over the selected time range.

spec.title: Avg durations by stage
spec.description: Average duration per request over all models for each stage plus proxy overhead (response minus stages, 5m rate window).

spec.title: Busy ratio
spec.description: Fraction of wall-clock time the LLM spends serving requests, over all models (5m rate window).

spec.title: Inter-token latency
spec.description: Average milliseconds per generated token over all models (5m rate window).

spec.title: Generation duration by model
spec.description: Average generation duration per model (sum/count, 5m window).

spec.expr: sum by (model) (rate(ollama_eval_duration_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_eval_duration_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9)

spec.title: Load duration by model
spec.description: Average model load duration per model (sum/count, 5m window).

spec.expr: sum by (model) (rate(ollama_load_duration_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_load_duration_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9)

spec.title: Model loads
spec.description: Model load events per second by model (5m rate window).

spec.title: Prefill duration by model
spec.description: Average prompt processing (prefill) duration per model (sum/count, 5m window).

spec.expr: sum by (model) (rate(ollama_prompt_eval_duration_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_prompt_eval_duration_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9)

spec.title: Tokens/s by model
spec.description: Average generation speed per model (sum/count, 5m window).

spec.expr: sum by (model) (rate(ollama_tokens_per_second_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_tokens_per_second_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9)

spec.title: p95/p99 durations by stage
spec.description: 95th and 99th percentile duration per request over all models for each stage (solid = p95, dashed = p99, 5m rate window).

spec.title: Prefill tok/s by model
spec.description: Prompt processing throughput per model: input tokens per second of prefill time (5m rate window).

spec.expr: sum by (model) (rate(ollama_tokens_processed_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_prompt_eval_duration_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9)

spec.title: Req/s avg
spec.description: Average requests per second over all models (5m rate window).

spec.title: Requests by model
spec.description: Request rate per model (5m rate).

spec.title: Response duration
spec.description: End-to-end response duration: average (sum/count) and p95, 5m window.

spec.title: Request time by stage
spec.description: Average duration per request stage: model load, prompt prefill and generation (sum/count, 5m window).

spec.title: Tokens generated by model
spec.description: Generated tokens per second per model (5m rate).

spec.title: Avg tokens per request
spec.description: Average prompt (input) and completion (output) size per request over all models (5m rate window).

spec.title: Tok/s avg
spec.description: Average generation speed (tokens per second) per request over all models (5m rate window).

spec.title: Exporter info
spec.description: Ollama exporter (Python) build and runtime info.

spec.title: Forecasts
spec.description: 24h linear forecasts per model mirroring the Models summary columns: predicted request/token totals, rates, generation speed and stage-average durations. Trend basis: selected time range. Forecast values are capped at 0. Only models with activity in the selected time range are shown.

spec.expr: clamp_min(sum by (model) (predict_linear(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range], 86400)), 0) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

clamp_min((sum by (model) (predict_linear(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range], 86400)) - sum by (model) (ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"})) / 86400, 0) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

clamp_min(sum by (model) (predict_linear(ollama_tokens_processed_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range], 86400)), 0) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

clamp_min(sum by (model) (predict_linear(ollama_tokens_generated_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range], 86400)), 0) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

clamp_min(predict_linear((sum by (model) (rate(ollama_tokens_per_second_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_tokens_per_second_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9))[$__range:1m], 86400), 0) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

clamp_min(predict_linear((sum by (model) (rate(ollama_response_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_response_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9))[$__range:1m], 86400), 0) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

clamp_min(predict_linear((sum by (model) (rate(ollama_load_duration_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_load_duration_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9))[$__range:1m], 86400), 0) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

clamp_min(predict_linear((sum by (model) (rate(ollama_prompt_eval_duration_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_prompt_eval_duration_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9))[$__range:1m], 86400), 0) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

clamp_min(predict_linear((sum by (model) (rate(ollama_eval_duration_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_eval_duration_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[5m])), 1e-9))[$__range:1m], 86400), 0) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

spec.title: Models summary
spec.description: Per model: total requests, input (processed) and output (generated) tokens, requests/s, generation speed and average response/load/prefill/generation durations over the selected time range. Only models with activity in the selected time range are shown.

spec.expr: sum by (model) (ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)
sum by (model) (ollama_tokens_processed_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)
sum by (model) (ollama_tokens_generated_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (model) (rate(ollama_tokens_per_second_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_tokens_per_second_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])), 1e-9) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (model) (rate(ollama_response_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_response_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])), 1e-9) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (model) (rate(ollama_load_duration_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_load_duration_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])), 1e-9) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (model) (rate(ollama_prompt_eval_duration_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_prompt_eval_duration_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])), 1e-9) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (model) (rate(ollama_eval_duration_seconds_sum{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (rate(ollama_eval_duration_seconds_count{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])), 1e-9) and on(model) (sum by (model) (rate(ollama_requests_total{job="proxy-ollama", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) > 0)

spec.title: Time composition by model
spec.description: Time spent per model per stage: load, prefill, generation and end-to-end response (seconds per second, selected time range).

spec.title: Models by requests
spec.description: Total requests per model since exporter start.

spec.title: Models by tokens generated
spec.description: Total generated tokens per model since exporter start.

spec.title: Load avg
spec.description: Average model load duration per request over the selected time range.

spec.title: Prefill avg
spec.description: Average prompt processing (prefill) duration per request over the selected time range.
